thread:
Priya: quick sync: propose tiny API for ephemeral overrides so infra teams can triage without long-lived config changes. thoughts?

Liam: +1. Name it POST /v1/ephemeral-overrides. keep POSIX-style ttl_seconds.

Carlos: require token_id and creator_role. default ttl 30m for normal users, 10m for ops tokens.

Marta: UI: show Active Overrides list with revoke button and small diff. search by token or incident.

Liam: server should validate ttl <= max_by_role and return code OVERRIDE_TTL_EXCEEDED. also accept expected_config_version to avoid blind apply.

Priya: telemetry: emit override.created/expired/revoked with labels {scope, creator_role}. sample 1% payloads for debugging.

Carlos: ops-bot: Created override eo-2026-900 by Liam for service/router-ap-south ttl=600s.

Marta: decision: ship API + server validation + audit event + UI list in MVP. follow-ups: approval queue, extended retention.

Liam: i'll draft spec. Priya: can you add audit schema?

Priya: yep, will add.
